content.description: Falcon is a next-generation Web3 infrastructure powered by a multi-factor model and artificial intelligence, designed to help traders make more informed trading decisions. The team behind Falcon operates as a leading quantitative hedge fund with its main office in the Cayman Islands. Since entering the cryptocurrency space in April 2018, the firm has prioritized strong risk control and stable profitability, navigating multiple bull and bear markets and earning several industry awards.
content.meta: Falcon by LUCIDA is a new generation Web 3.0 infrastructure driven by a multi-factor model and AI. Discover Falcon and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
